desc: Parse \(N\) and the binary string \(A\), preserving the ternary grouping structure.
Implement bottom-up DP pairs \((cost_0,cost_1)\) for all leaves.
Combine each consecutive triple into a parent pair using the minimum cost over valid child-output assignments.
Determine the root’s unchanged output and print the minimum leaf-flip cost to force the opposite output.
Validate the implementation against the provided samples and edge cases.
